facts.text: Spout Springs is home to North Carolina’s only natural hot springs, drawing visitors who seek mineral‑rich waters in a quiet Appalachian setting.
The town’s name literally means a place where water continuously spouts from the ground, a nod to its famous springs.
In the past, Spout Springs produced lumber and naval stores, supplying the region’s growing industries during the 19th century.
The Appalachian Trail winds through Spout Springs, offering hikers a scenic stretch right in the heart of the town.
The French Broad River runs through Spout Springs, adding a ribbon of water that complements the town’s natural springs.
The Hot Springs community, which includes Spout Springs, provides lodging options ranging from campsites to bed‑and‑breakfasts for travelers.
